purpose: Side-step July forensic before 018. Compare R9 teacher/oracle per-event capacity against current 017 regime-specialist ownership on the validated native-R9 event population. No new strategy is promoted.

static_viability_test.interpretation: Current pre-entry static state is not sufficient to separate toxic from viable events.

exact_tick_first_touch_diagnostic.important_caveat: Selection correlation only. Profitability must be replayed with entry at the proof tick; using signal-time PnL after observing proof would be look-ahead.
exact_tick_first_touch_diagnostic.interpretation: Fast first displacement contains materially more action information than the tested crude mandatory retest/rebreak sequence. Retest should be conditional, not universal.

cause_model: OPPORTUNITY_VIABILITY: July true no-edge/neither-side events nearly double.
DIRECTION_OWNERSHIP: one-side-only events increase and wrong-owner losses rise.
STATE_DURABILITY: regime age roughly halves even though classification confidence rises slightly; confidence is not durability.
MONETIZATION_CAPACITY: teacher-best excursion/payoff shrinks about 45%, matching winner-compression seen in formal Gamma_2 July.
STATIC_FEATURE_LIMIT: pre-entry correct winners and wrong-owner losses are very similar; dynamic post-event proof is required.
NEWS: scheduled macro windows are a minority of July fixed-cost loss and should remain secondary execution-risk context.
required_changes_to_018: Separate classification confidence from tradeability/viability confidence.
Add regime durability/age and excursion-capacity state.
Use two-stage logic: viability -> action ownership -> lifecycle.
For young/low-energy/low-confidence states, require exact-tick OCO first-touch proof before entry.
Prioritize 0.30/5s and 0.30/10s proof candidates for causal entry-at-proof replay.
Do not require retest/rebreak universally; test it only as a conditional confirmation after first touch.
Treat unresolved proof-window events as expiry/handoff, not forced entries.
Keep news as spread/slippage/size annotation unless incremental value replicates.
